name: Data source onboarding
intent: Bring an external source in with its rights, its schema and its provenance established before any of it is trusted.

steps.name: What the source is and what it publishes
Licence and rights, before anything is fetched at scale
steps.note: A hard stop. Unknown rights means no ingestion, not provisional ingestion.

steps.name: Analyse the real payload, not the documentation
Client contract: endpoints, pagination, rate limits, failure modes
Implement through Acme.HTTP, Req by default
steps.note: Direct Finch needs measured justification; Mint needs an architecture note.

steps.name: Raw retention with a checksum, before anything parses it
Validate the payload against the analysed schema
Lineage from raw blob to stored observation
Register the source with its policy

escalations.when: the source's schema changes under us
rate limits make the requirement infeasible

completion: quality report attached, with failing rows not just a rate
memory: the source's real rate limit as observed
evaluation: source reliability and latency telemetry over time
